protocol.dataset: SPair-71k Official Layout/large/test.txt (FULL 12,234 pairs, 481 unique images, 18 categories)
protocol.preprocessing: 280x280 white-padded square bicubic, ImageNet norm (100% identical to SOCO training)
protocol.metric: Official SPair-71k bbox-normalized PCK@0.10 (and @0.05), per-pair mean then category macro; Symmetric Physical-Part PCK@0.10 & Wrong-Role Error (WR) across 15 physical-part categories
protocol.bootstrap: 2000 replicates within-category shared-image vertex bootstrap, seed 20261121
